Browser WASM dependency notices

Includes the locked normal/build dependency closure and build-time macros, conservatively including code that may be removed by linking. Packages are unmodified. Original lesson/engine sources are MPL-2.0 in examples/. No upstream package is relicensed by the academy MIT license. Rust standard-library notices are in rust-standard-library-NOTICES.html.

Sources for every registry package: https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/NAME/VERSION/download (substitute the exact name/version below). Git Dusk core: https://github.com/dusk-network/rusk/tree/ae1a38a2079c681126a96f94c17d282ea2639946/core . Original source, lockfiles and engine modifications are available in this repository.

    the notice in Exhibit A, the Executable Form of such Source Code

        in Exhibit B to the Covered Software; or

    (b) that the Covered Software was made available under the terms of

    means any form of the work other than Source Code Form.

    a separate file or files, that is not Covered Software.

    means this document.

1.9. "Licensable"
    means having the right to grant, to the maximum extent possible,

    means Covered Software of a particular Contributor.

    the notice in Exhibit A, the Executable Form of such Source Code
    Form, and Modifications of such Source Code Form, in each case
    including portions thereof.

    means

        in Exhibit B to the Covered Software; or

        version 1.1 or earlier of the License, but not also under the
        terms of a Secondary License.

    means any form of the work other than Source Code Form.

    means a work that combines Covered Software with other material, in 
    a separate file or files, that is not Covered Software.

1.8. "License"
    means this document.

1.9. "Licensable"
    means having the right to grant, to the maximum extent possible,
    whether at the time of the initial grant or subsequently, any and
    all of the rights conveyed by this License.
